title: What Is Management?
subject: Business & Management
excerpt: Definitions, the four core functions, and why management matters in every organization.
body: Management is the process of coordinating people and resources to achieve organizational goals effectively and efficiently.
The four core functions are planning, organizing, leading and controlling.

title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
subject: AI & Data
excerpt: What AI really means, how machines learn, and the ideas behind the hype.
body: Artificial intelligence is the field of building systems that can perform tasks associated with human intelligence.
AI systems often learn patterns from data so they can classify, predict, recommend or generate.

quiz.question: What does AI commonly learn from?

title: The 4 Ps of Marketing
subject: Marketing
excerpt: Product, Price, Place and Promotion — the classic marketing mix explained.
body: The 4 Ps summarize the core decisions marketers make when bringing an offer to an audience.
A strong marketing mix aligns the product, price, distribution and promotion with customer needs.

title: How the Human Heart Works
subject: Health & Medical
excerpt: A simple tour of the heart, blood flow and the circulatory system.
body: The heart is a muscular pump that moves blood through the lungs and the rest of the body.
Blood carries oxygen and nutrients to cells and helps remove waste products.

title: Understanding Supply Chains
subject: Supply Chain & Operations
excerpt: From raw materials to the customer — the journey every product takes.
body: A supply chain is the network of people, organizations, resources and activities that move a product from origin to customer.
Good supply chains balance cost, speed, quality and reliability.

quiz.question: Where does a supply chain end?

title: What Is Business Analytics?
subject: AI & Data
excerpt: How organizations turn everyday data into smarter decisions.
body: Business analytics uses data, metrics and models to support better decisions.
It connects business questions with evidence from dashboards, reports and analysis.
